liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Tennessee Jed** (1 review): Energy after the North bound train line is out of this world [28]
- **Box of Rain** (1 review): First set closed with Box of Rain, following We Want Phil [33]
- **China Cat Sunflower** (1 review): Sequence from China Cat Sunflower to Uncle John's Band is top shelf [24]
- **The Other One** (1 review): The Other One is tremendous, with powerful tension building after the last lyrics [29]

## The recordings

- **gd1989-08-19.139669.mtx.photoLeon.LL.t-flac16** (recommended): matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 22 songs; 162 min; rated 5/5 by 1 [1]
- **gd89-08-19.schoeps.13254.sbeok.shnf**: source not stated; 21 songs; 156 min; rated 4.33/5 by 9 [2]. Said about its sound: Recording described as smoking, with performance like a Swiss watch [27]
- **gd1989-08-19.mtx.hansokolow.96303.sbeok.flac16**: matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 19 songs; 156 min; rated 5/5 by 2 [3]
- **gd89-08-19.sbd.5213.sbeok.shnf**: soundboard; 19 songs; 151 min; rated 4.53/5 by 19 [7]. Said about its sound: Recording features phenomenal clarity, sound field, and balance, resembling a Healy mix [24]
- **gd1989-08-19.sbd.walker-scotton.miller.83775.sbeok.flac16**: soundboard; 19 songs; 151 min; rated 3.33/5 by 12 [9]
- **gd1989-08-19.164141.UltraMatrix.sbd.cm.miller.t.flac1644**: soundboard; 19 songs; 153 min [11]

## Around the show

- Final Grateful Dead show at the Greek Theatre, concluding a three-day run [23]
- Attendee had a plane ticket back to Philly and a Greek ticket [26]
- Audience left during the Playin' Jam, returning as Uncle John's Band started [32]
- Among the best versions of The Other One played that year [25]
- Top three show out of 191 seen between 1985 and 1995 [32]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1989-08-19.139669.mtx.photoLeon.LL.t-flac16**: transferred by Three Source Matrix created in Audacity by photoLeon; source: Three Source Matrix created in Audacity [1]
- **gd89-08-19.schoeps.13254.sbeok.shnf**: taped by Jim Oade; source: Schoeps cmc42s ->M118 -> Oade Mod PCM-F1 [2]
- **gd1989-08-19.mtx.hansokolow.96303.sbeok.flac16**: transferred by hansokolow; source: Matrix mix (SBD/AUD) [3]. Also: Matrix created by hansokolow in ProTools from SBD cassette masters; Tapes provided by Paul Scotton and Joani Walker for seamless show [3]
- **gd89-08-19.sbd.5213.sbeok.shnf**: source: SBD Cassette Master > DAT > .WAV > .SHN [7]
- **gd1989-08-19.sbd.walker-scotton.miller.83775.sbeok.flac16**: transferred by Charlie Miller; source: SBD -> Cassette Master (TDK MA-XG90) D [9]. Also: Two SBD Cassette Masters used to make the show seamless [9]
- **gd1989-08-19.164141.UltraMatrix.sbd.cm.miller.t.flac1644**: taped by Set 1 recorded by Joani Walker -- Set 2 recorded by Don Pearson and Dan Healy; transferred by All Transfers and Mastering by Charlie Miller  February 11, 2023; source: Ultramatrix SBD > Cassette Master (Sony TC-D5M/Maxell MX90/TDK MA-XG90) [11]. Also: Multiple ultramatrix masters used to make this show complete [11]

claims.text: Final Grateful Dead show at the Greek Theatre, concluding a three-day run
Recording features phenomenal clarity, sound field, and balance, resembling a Healy mix
Sequence from China Cat Sunflower to Uncle John's Band is top shelf
Among the best versions of The Other One played that year
Attendee had a plane ticket back to Philly and a Greek ticket
Recording described as smoking, with performance like a Swiss watch
Energy after the North bound train line is out of this world
The Other One is tremendous, with powerful tension building after the last lyrics
Top three show out of 191 seen between 1985 and 1995
Audience left during the Playin' Jam, returning as Uncle John's Band started
First set closed with Box of Rain, following We Want Phil
Matrix created by hansokolow in ProTools from SBD cassette masters
Tapes provided by Paul Scotton and Joani Walker for seamless show
Two SBD Cassette Masters used to make the show seamless
Set 1 recorded by Joani Walker; Set 2 by Don Pearson and Dan Healy
Multiple ultramatrix masters used to make this show complete
